clauses.quote: Before recommending a teacher transfer, the principal and/or the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator will meet with the teacher involved to discuss the proposed transfer and the reasons thereof.
clauses.subject_text: the principal and/or the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator

clauses.quote: No administrative transfer will be made arbitrarily, capriciously, or without a written explanation of the reason for the transfer.
If the teacher objects to the proposed transfer, the teacher may request a meeting with the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator to discuss the matter.
Administrative transfers will be recommended by the principal and/or the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator
and will take effect only after approval by the appropriate Assistant Superintendent.
In filling promotional vacancies, preference shall be given to personnel already employed in the District providing other qualifications are substantially equal.
Applicants for such promotions shall be notified of the final decision in writing.

No certificated position for credit classes in the Adult and Community Schools shall be filled by a teacher not employed by the District during the regular school term if there is a qualified applicant for such position who is employed by the District during the regular term.
clauses.subject_text: No certificated position for credit classes in the Adult and Community Schools
clauses.notes: Negated subject functions as a hiring prohibition.

clauses.quote: In filling such positions, consideration will be given to a teacher's area of competence, major and minor fields of study, quality of performance, and ability to relate well with students.

Teachers employed in adult and community school credit classes shall be paid an hourly rate, according to their current contract salary as a regular teacher in the District, to a maximum hourly rate based on step four of the teacher's salary lane.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers employed in adult and community school credit classes
